title: Desk worker, total beginner, home
message: Hi! I'm 34 and I sit at a desk all day. I've never really worked out. I'd like to get generally fitter and a bit stronger. I can do 3 sessions a week, 30 minutes max each, at home. I have a sturdy chair and some floor space, no other equipment. No injuries.

checks.why: a beginner recovers poorly from high volume
